# Spiking_Policy_Network

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A policy representation in reinforcement learning where the action-selection network is implemented as a spiking neural network. It enables energy-efficient, event-driven policy inference within in-network neuromorphic control loops.
